evidence.domain: no new domain logic — pure customer navigation presentation layer with no transactional changes or new business invariants
evidence.persistence: no new persistence — navigation metadata and labels are static configuration, not stored
evidence.service: apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx defines the persistent warm customer shell; apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/account-top-tabs.tsx renders the top navigation menu with the exact seven destination labels (Overview, Wardrobe, My Appointments, Orders, Digital Fitting Room, Rewards & Referrals, My Profile); apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/customer-navigation-lifecycle.tsx manages warm navigation state and client-side routing; apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/intent-prefetch-link.tsx supports client-side navigation without full page reloads
evidence.origin_ui: apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/account-top-tabs.tsx — renders desktop and mobile navigation with client-side link handling; desktop shows all seven navigation tabs in correct order with correct hrefs; mobile shows first three destinations inline with a 'More' overflow button providing access to remaining destinations
evidence.receiver_ui: apps/customer/app/(dashboard)/layout.tsx — customer shell is persistent across navigation; no full page reloads when navigating between destinations; app shell element reference remains the same after client-side navigation
evidence.rls: no new RLS requirements — navigation is presentation-only and does not introduce new data-access patterns beyond existing customer session scope
evidence.exceptions: no new exceptions — all seven navigation destinations respect existing customer RLS boundaries; attempting to navigate to any destination without authentication fails before the nav component renders
evidence.browser: apps/customer/e2e/customer-navigation-v3-copy.spec.ts — authenticated E2E Customer Workspace persona against local Supabase stack; desktop 1280x800 + mobile 390x844; 8/8 passed at gitSha 2c4a627 (docs/evidence/runs/20.15.json). Desktop tests verify: (1) exactly 7 navigation tabs in correct order with correct hrefs, (2) navigation is client-side with no full page reloads, (3) no forbidden 'house' wording in navigation labels, (4) console-clean warm navigation across all destinations. Mobile tests verify: (1) first 3 destinations inline with 'More' overflow menu, all destinations reachable, (2) mobile navigation is client-side, (3) no forbidden 'house' wording in mobile navigation, (4) console-clean warm navigation across all destinations; zero console errors on all tests
